description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Archive an inventory item instead of deleting it (status archived, archived_at set; valuations, people links and photos are kept). Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "archive_inventory_item", arguments: { inventory_id } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call archive_inventory_item with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. ($0.10; API key required)

inventory_id.description: The item id from add_inventory_item, get_inventory or search_inventory.

preview_id.description: preview_id returned by preview_destructive_change for this tool.

reason.description: Why it is archived (kept on the receipt).

request_id.description: Required idempotency key; retries return the original receipt.

restore_window_acknowledged.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview and its 30-day restore window.

name: archive_inventory_item

restore_id.description: Pass to restore_change to undo within restore_window_days.

title: Archive Inventory Item
